description.value: A community-focused craft brewpub on the Sunshine Coast, brewing award-winning beers inspired by the coastal lifestyle since 2017. The patio overlooks Howe Sound and has been voted best patio by the Sunshine Coast People's Choice Awards. The on-site Burger Shack serves food seven days a week, making it a reliable refuelling stop for touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms an active brewpub with burger shack, patio overlooking Howe Sound, dine-in and online ordering for pickup. Address, phone (778-462-2337), and website all confirmed via footer on every page. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, dietary options, or any cycling-specific amenities on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone; website shows 778-462-2337 — added from website
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active brewpub with food service open seven days a week in Gibsons, a key stop on Sunshine Coast cycling routes. Reliable food, drink, and takeout for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: voted best patio by the Sunshine Coast People's Choice Awards
